# Pizza Ratto

> Italian soul. Street-corner attitude. Wood-fired pizza shop in Salt River, Cape Town, South Africa. Hand-stretched pizza, caffè and dolci, plus a small deli and merchandise range. Collection only: order on WhatsApp, by phone or on Uber Eats. Meat toppings are halal.

Address: 20 Brickfield Road, Salt River, Cape Town. Hours: Monday–Saturday, 12:00–21:00. Closed Sunday. Phone / WhatsApp: 082 525 0380. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pizza_ratto/

## Pages

- [Home and menu](https://pizzaratto.com/): pizza menu with prices, caffè, cold drinks, desserts, opening hours and how to order
- [Deli](https://pizzaratto.com/deli.html): hot honey, chilli sauce, spice blends, limoncello and other take-home items
- [Merchandise](https://pizzaratto.com/merchandise.html): helmet keyrings, jackets, stickers, pins and Vespa-inspired gear
